title: Reduction of the nonzero characteristic-zero polynomial fibre
statement: Let A be a Noetherian complete local domain with characteristic-zero fraction field, q a maximal ideal of A[X] over its maximal ideal, and nonzero r ≤ q a prime contracting to zero in A. There exist a characteristic-zero regular Noetherian complete local domain A₀ in the same universe and maximal/prime ideals q₀,r₀ of A₀[X], with q₀ over its maximal ideal, nonzero r₀ ≤ q₀ over zero, such that regularity of the completion fibre at r₀ implies geometric regularity of the original fibre at r. This asserts only the finite-subring transfer step, not regularity of the smaller fibre. The notions use [def-weil-pbc-noetherian-ring], [def-weil-pbc-adically-complete-ring], [def-weil-pbc-adic-completion], [def-weil-polynomial-ring], [def-weil-pbc-localization-at-prime], [def-weil-pbc-g-ring]. Regularity is in the sense of [def-weil-regular-scheme], applied to the affine spectrum.

proof.text: Choose a regular complete local coefficient subring using 032D. Finiteness of the polynomial extension gives quasi-finiteness; integral contraction preserves the primes and nonzero contraction follows after passage to the finite fraction-field extension.
The characteristic-zero residue field has only trivial purely inseparable extensions. Noetherianity and regularity of the contracted fibre thus imply geometric regularity. Apply 07PP(1).

theorem completeLocalNonzeroFibreCharZero_reduction
    (A : Type u) [CommRing A] [IsDomain A] [IsNoetherianRing A] [IsLocalRing A]
    [IsAdicComplete (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal A) A]
    (q : Ideal (Polynomial A)) [q.IsMaximal]
    (hq : q.comap (Polynomial.C : A →+* Polynomial A) = IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal A)
    [CharZero (Localization.AtPrime (⊥ : Ideal A))]
    (r : Ideal (Polynomial A)) [r.IsPrime] (hrq : r ≤ q) (hr : r ≠ ⊥)
    (hrA : r.comap (Polynomial.C : A →+* Polynomial A) = ⊥) :
    ∃ (A₀ : Type u) (_ : CommRing A₀) (_ : IsDomain A₀) (_ : IsNoetherianRing A₀)
      (_ : IsRegularLocalRing A₀) (_ : CharZero A₀)
      (_ : IsLocalRing A₀) (_ : IsAdicComplete (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal A₀) A₀)
      (q₀ r₀ : Ideal (Polynomial A₀)) (_ : q₀.IsMaximal) (_ : r₀.IsPrime),
      q₀.comap (Polynomial.C : A₀ →+* Polynomial A₀) = IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal A₀ ∧
      r₀ ≤ q₀ ∧ r₀ ≠ ⊥ ∧
      r₀.comap (Polynomial.C : A₀ →+* Polynomial A₀) = ⊥ ∧
      (IsRegularRing (r₀.Fiber (AdicCompletion (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal (Localization.AtPrime q₀))
          (Localization.AtPrime q₀))) →
       Algebra.IsGeometricallyRegular r.ResidueField
        (r.Fiber (AdicCompletion (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal (Localization.AtPrime q))
          (Localization.AtPrime q))))
